units.source_text: 源侍从薰君东奔西走，歌舞了一夜，非常疲乏，躺下了身子。

en.t: Genji's chamberlain, Lord Kaoru, had been running here and there, singing and dancing all night, and he was so exhausted that he lay down.

units.source_text: 忽然冷泉院派人来召唤他。

en.t: Suddenly, Retired Emperor Reizei sent someone to summon him.

units.source_text: 他说：“唉，我好吃力！正想休息一下呢。”

en.t: He said, "Ah, this is hard on me! I was just thinking of resting for a while."

units.source_text: 只得勉强起身，来到御前。

en.t: He had no choice but to force himself up and come before His Majesty.

units.source_text: 冷泉院向他探问宫中踏歌情况，又说道：“领唱向来是由年长者担任的，这回选用你这少年人，倒比往年更好呢。”

en.t: Retired Emperor Reizei asked him about the palace stepping-song ceremony and then said, "The lead singer has always been an older man, but choosing a young person like you this time was even better than in past years."
He seemed to be showing Kaoru special affection.

units.source_text: 冷泉院随口吟唱着《万春乐》，走向新皇妃那边去，薰君随驾同行。

en.t: Retired Emperor Reizei casually hummed "Banshunraku" as he went toward the new imperial consort, and Lord Kaoru accompanied him.

units.source_text: 众侍女娘家来看踏歌会的女客甚多，各处都很热闹，一片繁华景象。

en.t: Many female visitors from the ladies-in-waiting's families had come to watch the stepping-song gathering, so every place was lively and splendid.

units.source_text: 薰君暂在走廊门口坐地，和相识的侍女谈话。

en.t: Lord Kaoru sat for a while at the doorway of the corridor and talked with ladies-in-waiting he knew.

units.source_text: 他说：“昨夜月光太明亮了，反而教人难以为情。

en.t: He said, "Last night the moonlight was so bright that it actually made one feel awkward.

units.source_text: 藏人少将似乎被照得两眼发眩的样子，其实不是为月光而怕羞呢。

en.t: The Minor Captain of the Chamberlains looked as if the light had dazzled his eyes, but in truth he was not embarrassed because of the moonlight.

units.source_text: 他在宫中时并不是这样的。”

en.t: When he was in the palace, he was not like that."

units.source_text: 有的侍女听了，对藏人少将很同情。

en.t: Some of the ladies-in-waiting heard this and felt great sympathy for the Minor Captain of the Chamberlains.

units.source_text: 又有人称赞薰君，说道：“你真是‘春夜何妨暗’啊！

en.t: Others praised Lord Kaoru, saying, "You truly are proof that a spring night need not mind being dark!

units.source_text: 昨夜映着月光，姿态更见艳丽了。

en.t: Last night, set against the moonlight, your figure looked even more graceful and beautiful.
That is how everyone was judging it."
Then a lady-in-waiting from behind the blinds recited a poem, saying:
